title: ConfigurationPatchRequest
description: Request to change environment configurations and settings

dtapMode.description: DTAP mode of the environment can be Development or Production

appUrl.description: URL of the app deployed in the environment

clientIdForSecretStore.description: Client ID for access external secret store

adminPassword.description: Admin password of the app deployed in the environment

isAdminPasswordSecretStore.description: Indicate if Admin Password is stored as external secret, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

leaderlessMode.description: Indicate if the environment is in leaderless mode

Constants.description: Constants of the app deployed in the environment

isSecretStore.description: Indicate if Constant is stored as external secret, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

visibility.description: Indicate if Constant is visible or hidden, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

ScheduledEvents.description: Scheduled events of the app deployed in the environment

CustomEnvironmentVariables.description: Variables of the app deployed in the environment

CustomRuntimeSettings.description: Runtime settings of the app deployed in the environment

isSecretStore.description: Indicate if Custom Runtime Settings is stored as external secret, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

CustomHttpHeaders.description: HTTP headers of the environment network

CustomJVMOptions.description: JVM options of the environment model
CustomJVMOptions.title: CustomJVMOptions

CustomJettyOptions.description: Jetty options of the environment model
CustomJettyOptions.title: CustomJettyOptions

Debugger.description: Debugger of the app deployed in the environment
Debugger.title: Debugger

enabled.description: Indicate if Debugger is enabled for the environment

isSecretStore.description: Indicate if Debugger password is stored as external secret, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

ClientCertificates.description: Client certificates of the environment network

CustomTLSConfig.description: TLS configuration of the environment network
CustomTLSConfig.title: CustomTLSConfig

coreResourcePlan.description: Core Resource Plan for environment, it's only for Connected mode.

coreResourceSize.description: Core Resource Size for environment, it's for both Connected and Standalone modes.

cpuRequest.description: Cpu cores request should not be lower than 0.1 CPU

cpuLimit.description: Cpu cores limit should not be lower than 0.1 CPU

memRequest.description: Memory request should not be lower than 0.512 GB

memLimit.description: Memory limit should not be lower than 0.512 GB

ephemeralRequest.description: Ephemeral Storage request should not be lower than 1 GB

ephemeralLimit.description: Ephemeral storage limit should not be lower than 1 GB
